dependency_scope: The campaign dependencies below describe the verification route. An admissible refutation is an alternative route, not a proof of the manuscript's main theorem.

C9000319.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 319 (Counterexamples to finite generation at chromatic height two.; papers: Counterexamples to the Hahn-Wilson conjecture at height two; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: For sufficiently large p, the manuscript constructs a connective p-complete spectrum X of exact fp-type two, outside Thick(BP<2>_p-complete), with L_2^f X = L_2 X and L_T(2) X = L_K(2) X (thm:main).

C_CHART.statement: The actual height-two chart has faithful tangent-to-identity H-action on k[[x]], Gamma_s = H(2s+1), g_i^(p^s) in Gamma_s, and gr k[[H]] = k[A,B,C] with weights 1,1,3 (geom:thickened-charts, geom:group-filtration, geom:skew-filtration).

C_ORBIT_INPUTS.statement: Orbit congruences z_h = h(x)/x have nested finite-index subgroups H_l, balanced representatives b_j, exact congruence counts, and sum_l 1/N_l <= p/(p-1) (op:displacement and the balanced-sequence construction).

C_LEVEL_INPUTS.statement: For every s >= 1, Gamma_s is contained in H_(p^s) and N_(p^s) >= p^(3(s-1)) (op:displacement).

C_ORBIT_LATTICE.statement: A family independent modulo x^n gives an integral orbit-function lattice of the same rank; its reduction is injective, and every coefficient in this lattice has valuation at least -3(n+L_0).

C_RESIDUE_LEVEL.statement: Residues of the orbit lattice are represented by integral-valued polynomials of degree J = 3n+4L_0 and factor through H/Gamma_s when N_(p^s) > J.

C_SEMILINEAR_ANN.statement: Both equations integral h(mu(g)) phi(hg) = 0 persist under K_0-linear orbit-function combinations and reduce to annihilation of all left translates of bar a_1 and bar b_1.

C_GROUP_QUOTIENT.statement: If (sigma(bar a_1)) = (C), sigma(bar b_1) is outside (C), and t = p^s, then dim Omega/(Omega bar a_1 + Omega bar b_1 + ker(Omega -> k[H/Gamma_s])) <= d t, where d is the degree of sigma(bar b_1) modulo C.

C_OBS_GROWTH.statement: Under the exact hypotheses of obs:growth, every n >= 1 and fixed L_0 >= 0 satisfy dim_k image({f in x^(-L_0)R: a_1(f)=b_1(f)=0} -> K_0/x^n R) = O((1+n)^(1/3)).
C_OBS_GROWTH.engineer_result: Universal prose proof gives v(n)^3 <= D^3 p^6 (3n+4L_0); exact subclaim replay passed. Three upstream chart assumptions and independent Reviewer acceptance remain outstanding.

C_OPERATOR.statement: The prescribed integral operator has reduction U_3 and initial symbol C, finite crossing, and persistent unmatched rows and columns of growth exponent beta > 1/3 (op:operator).

C_GLUE.statement: The paired overlap lattice produces U with finite homotopy in each degree and completion Y, and supplies at least c N^beta simultaneous pairs independent at Laurent precision qN+1 (glue:overlap, glue:pairs, glue:object).

C_MICROLOCAL.statement: The coefficient extension to S[t^+-1] is flat on both sides; S is a left and right principal domain and S/aS is nonzero torsion (obs:microlocal-flat, obs:principal).

C_DUAL_GHOST.statement: For every global map g:U -> P with P in Thick(T'), vanishing of microlocal ordinary homology implies vanishing of microlocal dual homology (obs:dual-ghost).

C_TOWER.statement: The two-test torsion criterion excludes all finite towers and retracts, not merely finite sums (rew:obs:tower-criterion).

C_NONMEMBERSHIP.statement: The glued object U does not belong to Thick(T') (obs:nonmembership).

C_TRANSFER.statement: Comparison and connective-cover transfer turn U into a connective p-complete fp-type-at-most-two spectrum outside the prescribed finite-construction category (transfer:criterion).

C_EXACT_TYPE.statement: The transferred spectrum has exact fp-type two (scope:exact-height).

C_TELESCOPES.statement: The transferred spectrum satisfies both asserted finite/Bousfield and T(2)/K(2) localization comparisons (scope:telescopes).

C_DIVIDED_DIFFERENCES.statement: The balanced divided-difference operators D_m are integral, kill u_g^j for j<m, take u_g^m to x^r_m, and take u_g^j for j>m into x^(r_m+j-m)R (op:divided-differences).

C_COMPLETION.statement: Completion is exact; completed finite constructions admit strict realization by perfect operation modules, and maps between the relevant objects induce continuous overlap maps (complete:fracture, complete:realization, complete:topology).

C_ANNIHILATOR_REMOVAL.statement: A right x-saturated ideal J containing a Delta with JS=S has an integral member whose reduced symbol is outside (C); separately, an operator outside Sa annihilating V in ker(a) yields an integral annihilator of V with reduced symbol outside (C) (obs:right-annihilator).

C_ADJOINT.statement: The constant-term pairing gives every integral operator an integral adjoint; reduction induces group inversion and preserves both symbol conditions of obs:growth (obs:adjoint).

C_GLOBAL_MAPS.statement: Global maps out of the glued object preserve the discrete overlap lattice images needed in the paired-lattice argument (glue:global-maps).

C_PERIODIC_SPLITTING.statement: Over a left and right principal domain, finite modules split into finite free and torsion parts with free resolution length at most one; perfect positive-even-periodic dg modules split into periodizations of homology (obs:periodic-splitting).

C_TOWER_NORMAL_FORM.statement: Every object in Thick(T_0) is a retract of a finite tower whose layers are finite sums of arbitrary shifts of T_0 (rew:obs:tower-normal-form).
